Manage the agent environment

Usage:
  adbuddy env [command]

Available Commands:
  init        Create or refresh the agent environment (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, permissions, adb shim)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for env

Global Flags:
      --json   print machine-readable JSON on stdout

Use "adbuddy env [command] --help" for more information about a command.
